## 主张 Claim

一项形成若使它依存或取用的每个条件都持续支持依存于该条件的每项形成，则为更新型；若它取用的某个条件使某个依存者永久失去支持，则为消耗型。在任意展开上两类互斥而不穷尽；无更新的取用只容许有限次发生。条件若由依存于它的形成更新，超出更新的取用会永久终止这一更新：依存于该条件的焦点形成随之终止自身、形成量有界，不依存的焦点形成则可以持续并无界形成。每次发生都形成新组织不能决定分类，焦点形成在整个展开中的自身发生与形成轨迹也不能。各方单独都在更新之内时，共同取用仍可消耗；起初在更新之内的升级也可消耗。不使用任何规范前提或 Lean 公理。 / A formation is renewing when every condition it depends on or draws on keeps supporting each formation that depends on that condition, and consuming when it draws on a condition some dependent formation permanently loses. Over arbitrary unfoldings the classes are exclusive and not exhaustive, and unrenewed drawdown admits finitely many active steps. When the condition is renewed by a formation that depends on it, drawing beyond renewal permanently ends that renewal: a dependent focal formation then ends itself with bounded formation, while an independent one can persist and form without bound. Forming new organization at every active step does not decide the class, nor does the focal formation's own activity and formation over the whole unfolding. Joint drawing can consume when each party alone is within renewal, and escalation that begins within renewal can consume. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [RelationalRenewal.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/RelationalRenewal.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 一般部分只有定义：展开给出条件水平、发生、带支持水平的依存及取用；Dependent 表示形成只在受支持时发生。 / General part: definitions only. An unfolding supplies condition levels, activity, dependence with support levels, and drawing; Dependent states that a formation is active only where supported.
- 规律族：一个以自然数水平表示的共享条件；条件支持维持性形成时加入更新；焦点形成在受支持时发生（支持水平为零表示不依存），并按给定量贡献与取用。 / Law family: one shared condition with natural-number levels; renewal is added while the condition supports the sustaining formation; the focal formation is active while supported (zero support level means independence) and contributes and draws stated amounts.
- 共同取用表示为取用相加的一条规律；当各取用者支持水平相同时这一表示是精确的。 / Joint drawing is represented as one law with the summed draw, exact when the drawing formations share the same support level.

形成、条件与依存是同一展开中分化的方面，不是交换资源的所有者。把规律族读作恶性增长、升级竞赛或以消耗取胜属于解释；实际案例须为其依存、支持水平与速率取得证据。`formed` 计数新组织单位，不是复杂度量。 / Formations, conditions and dependence are differentiated aspects of one unfolding, not owners exchanging resources. Readings of the law family as malignant growth, escalation or winning by consumption are interpretations; actual cases require evidence for their dependence, support levels and rates. `formed` counts units of new organization and is not a complexity measure.

完成的是所述表示中的描述性分类及其动力学。未证明真实过程满足规律族，未说明更新循环中的损失如何权衡，也未完成 Becoming 的零附加实质公理根基。其伦理意义不是 G0 之外另欠的工作：G0 的对象是生生，本分类描述的正是生生；消耗与其不发生在 C 下的比较，见另一记录 relational-reading-comparison。Consumed 不要求依存曾被满足：一个从未被满足的依存使条件被消耗、汲取者成为消耗型，而没有任何断裂或丧失（独立审查 Q2；见 becoming-dependence-dynamics 的 Unmet.consumed_without_loss）。本模块的字节与主张不变。 / Completes a descriptive classification and its dynamics within the stated representations. It does not show that real processes satisfy the law family, how losses within a renewed cycle are weighed, or that the zero-substantive-axiom foundation of Becoming is complete. Its ethical significance is not an addition owed beyond G0: G0's object is 生生, which this classification describes; the comparison of consumption with its absence under C is the separate record relational-reading-comparison. Consumed does not require the dependence ever to have been met: a requirement never met makes the condition consumed and the drawer consuming without any break or loss (independent review Q2; see Unmet.consumed_without_loss in becoming-dependence-dynamics).
